risk_note: RV2 (console agreement versions; OPS-14). Permission point content.agreement; list and version reads without step-up; publish needs a totp step-up (consumed only on success). Publish runs in one transaction: per-(app, type) advisory lock, current-version CAS (20902 resource=agreement), F1-02m publish checks and the F1-02v body / link checks (no banned-word scan for agreements, L42), url built with agreementTextUrl from an https h5_base_url (else 50001, L43), refusal when legal.<type>.version is already >= the new version (50001, L44), then article row (category agreement, published, outside the article state machine, L34), agreement row, legal.* config and its history, and the audit row; any failure rolls everything back; a unique violation maps to 20902. Blank confirmer / note are refused with JS trim; a previous version pointing at another app's article is refused. Two rule-test defects (audit rows with BigInt ids, the empty union-host table) were fixed mechanically by the orchestrator before the implementation. One S2 (list and count read outside one snapshot) is tracked as a follow-up. No funds. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
